name: Calculate docker image
description: Determine docker image to pull, building a new one if necessary.

use-custom-docker-registry.description: Use the custom ECR registry. Applies only if build.sh exists in docker-build-dir.

docker-image-name.description:
The name of a docker image, like `pytorch-linux-focal-linter`. A fullname
with ECR prefix is also supported.

docker-build-dir.description:
The directory containing the build.sh shell script to build the docker image.
The script parameters can be passed to docker build similar to how it is used
in P

docker-build-script.description: The script to build the docker image. Should be relative to the docker-build-dir.

docker-build-timeout-minutes.description: The timeout to build the docker image.

custom-tag-prefix.description: The prefix to use for the docker image tag.  You can also just do imagename:customtag

working-directory.description: The working directory where the repo is checked out.

docker-registry.description: The registry to store the image after it is built.

always-rebuild.description: If set to any value, always build a fresh docker image.

push.description: If set to true, push the image to ECR.

force-push.description: If set to true, always push the image to ECR even if it exists.

repo-name.description: The name of the repository containing the docker-build-dir.

ci-docker-hash.description:
If provided, the action validates this value against the computed docker
hash (from `git rev-parse HEAD:<docker-build-dir>`) and fails if they do
not match.
